nom: Elizabeth Arden Eight Hour HydraPlay Skin Perfecting Daily Moisturizer

avis.texte: The packaging is super cute and makes it mess free and easy to use. The application and ingredients are also great and has helped my skin feel so hydrated and smooth.

8 hour cream smells awful - like Vaseline, which is basically it's main ingredient- 56%, along with mineral oil, lanolin, and the preservativeBHT along with small amounts of other things. Cera Ve healing cream however is only 46% petroleum and includes ceramides and hyaluronic acid along with other decent stuff, does NOT have that funny smell, and costs waaaaayyyy less. I don't get the "cult" following of this overpriced product. Bet this review does not get posted.
I'm new to Elizabeth Arden and I thought I'd try out the Eight Hour products. All really great and they really last all day. I'm already looking into what else is available.

avis.titre: Just cant get past the smell
avis.texte: I have tried the hand cream 3 separate times and can't get over the smell. Really want to love it but can't
This is the best for my dry under eyes, I use it at night. Also great for lips, cuticles, everything. A must have
I love this product and have been using it for years. I just wish it were more affordable.
Ive been using this product for years on myself and 2 girls. Now on my grandchildren. Its remarkable.

avis.titre: Great for my dry hands and elbows
avis.texte: I received this as part of an Influenster campaign. I recall Elizabeth Arden as a beauty brand from the 80s and I am also vegetarian so my expectations were low and I was a little reluctant to use the product. But it is truly a protectant cream! You can really smell the lanolin in it, but it's not like slathering talllow on your skin. In the end the smell fades and you don't really smell it after a while. I use it at night on my hands, elbows, and feet before bed and it really works well to soften my dry, ashy skin. When this tube is gone I will definitely buy it!
I have been using this for years. I hope they keep making it.

I enjoyed using this cream on the sides of my nose where I get dry spots as well as under my eyes for a nice refresh and give some more life. I will say this cream is very thick and does not soak into skin that easily so I liked to use while being out and about rather than before bed. My boyfriend even enjoyed this cream and would use on him face and neck after shaving since he is very prone is redness, dryness and cuts after shaving and he said this helped soothe those areas.

The texture and effectiveness reminded me of aquaphor. I really liked the nice packaging. Ingredients were okay. But I just couldn't get over the scent. I am also pregnant so I have been a little sensitive in that area I hope it is just that.

avis.titre: The original Elizabeth Arden Eight Hour Cream was
avis.texte: I really wanted to like the original Elizabeth Arden Eight Hour Cream Skin Protectant, but I just couldn't get past the earthy, heavy scent. I'm not a fan of strongly fragranced products, and unfortunately, this one wasn't for me.

I use this product as recommended and one way I love to use it the most is to use it on my hands specially on my cuticles it leaves my hand moisturized with that stock or oil filling. I also use it to shape my brows when I'm on the go and just want to tame down my brows.

avis.titre: Excellent Skin Protection and Multi Purpose Cream
avis.texte: This cream has an unusual odor, however it fades fairly quick. I love this because not only does it have a creamy base but it also contains SA which gently exfoliates and keeps pores clear so you do not have to worry about acne. This is an excellent skin protectant and truly stood the test of time. The texture is more like an ointment for reference.

I was really impressed with the effectiveness of the Eight Hour Cream Skin Protectant, especially during harsh cold weather. My lips were extremely chapped, and after applying it before bed, I noticed a significant improvement overnight—they felt soothed and much more hydrated by morning. The texture is smooth and comforting, providing an immediate sense of relief. While the scent wasn't my favorite, it's a minor drawback compared to how well it works. The packaging is also a plus—sleek, practical, and easy to carry around. Definitely a must-have for winter skincare!

I'm disappointed with the lack of information on their ingredient list. Not on the box nor packaging, and not listed on the website under the product. I wanted to know because the smell was very strong and smelled like Vicks. Will not be using this because of the ingredient discretion. It was very thick and obviously made of petroleum

This product is very moisturizing. I'm a nurse and my hands get very dry because I would use hand gel and wash my hands very frequently at work. I gave it 4 stars only because of its thickness. It really helps with my dry hands and helps soften my skin but it somewhat feels greasy, it just needs a little time to soak in. But hey, it works!

The texture and formula of this product is much different than what I expected from the name. I thought this would be a lotion but it has more of a petroleum jelly-like feel. It is very thick and sticky going on, so a little goes a long way. I tried putting this on the bottom of my cracked feet and the first time I used way too much product and had residue. I would use a pea-sized amount. This product does well at helping those chapped places, but it's not for me. It has a very medicinal smell to me. Kind of a mix between cherry and mint, which may be some people's cup of tea, but it's not for me. Also I don't like the lingering sticky residue.

I really liked using this on my cuticles and hands. It keeps them moisturized and prevents cracking. It does have a strong herbal scent which I'm not that fond of, but it eventually fades. A little goes a long way so this will definitely last a while.

This is literally the only thing that stops my nose from peeling. Nothing else works like it. It's thick, healing, and I swear by it. I put it on at night and wake up smooth. Even though it says "cream," it's more of an ointment—and honestly, that's what makes it better. Total skin saver.

This cream feels more like a balm on the skin, a but greasier than cream or lotion. I was not able to wear on my face for this reason, and it's got a strong fragrance. Worked great on keeping my cuticles and dry spots like my elbows and knees moisturized! Hydrating and a bit heavy but good for dry skin.

Soft and silky feeling left on skin after using this moisturizer at night. It works not just on skin, but also on the lips and can be used on your eyebrows as eyebrow gel! Super easy to use, the packaging is great.

This is way overpriced Vaseline, like literally, the only active ingredient is petroleum! Except for I prefer Vaseline because it doesn't smell like diesel. The smell doesn't dissipate it hangs around for-ev-ver. I used it one time as a night time face moisturizer NO WAY NEVER again. You can't use it under makeup because it's petroleum jelly. IT IS PETROLEUM JELLY! Save your money and buy regular Vaseline that the smell is tolerable. My honey asked me if I missed the gas tank. Do not get on any material bc it doesn't wipe off. Definitely would not recommend! IT IS LITERALLY PETROLEUM JELLY!!!!

I recieved the Elizabeth Arden Eight Hour Cream Skin Protectant from Influenster for complimentary testing purposes. I wish I liked this more. Its very tacky and doent have a very pleasant scent. I am going to give it another try deeper into the summer. I'll try it if I get any sunburn or things of that nature.
This product has saved my extremely dry skin and lips. I love it.
My skin gets so dry, particularly in the winter. I love the versatility of this product. It makes skin glow and hydrates immediately. I use it on my face, hands, chest, and elbows.

I absolutely love this cream! I really don't enjoy the scent but it works great. The packaging is easy to use. The cream is very thick and a little goes a long way! I recommend this if you suffer from very dry skin. It works !

I wanted to like this because it's a skin protectant. It would've been good to put on my face overnight. Unfortunately this stinks so bad, and I cannot tolerate the smell. It smells like a hospital cleaner. It's really odd.
A bottle filled with goodness. The ingredients are safe and the consistency is gel like. It's good on dry skin and protects it well. Light scented and worth it.

I use this product mostly for "slugging" overnight. It takes care of dry patches and sooth irritations in just one use. The texture is more of a balm than cream. I also use it on my lips and cuticle and anywhere I need extra moisture.

While I can see the appeal do the Eight Hour Cream Skin Protectant, I can't say it's a new favorite of mine. I have questions - why is Elizabeth Arden trying to convince me this heavy petroleum based gel is a cream? Why is this labeled as 'lightly scented'? The Eight Hour Cream will definitely add moisture to your skin and can be used for a natural looking highlight. Great for slugging moisture into dry feet or elbows, but I couldn't imagine it as a hand moisturizer. I tried it and doubt a sensory nightmare. The light fragrance reminds me of something I can't quite place and don't enjoy - possibly plain argan oil? The tube will get used, but it will take me a minute and I don't anticipate repurchasing.

avis.titre: On-the-go moisturizing lip & hand petroleum jelly
avis.texte: Given the dense, gel-like texture, feels more like an enhanced pink petroleum jelly rather than skincare cream. Is really effective in moisturizing dry patches like on your lips, heels, & cuticles, but due to its greasiness wouldn't recommend applying all over the face or bigger areas of skin since it's not as easy to rub or spread out. Also has a herbal/medicinal scent, which I personally don't mind but may be offputting for others. Great size for on-the-go so I leave it in my workbag and office desk to reapply throughout the day.

The Elizabeth Arden Eight Hour Cream is actually a petrolatum-rich skin protectant. It looks like an orange gelee and it smells medicinal. I have very sensitive skin that reacts to most things, so I thought with the menthol smell it would definitely cause my skin to redden, but it seemed to slightly soothe it and reviewers with average skin types say it is very soothing and healing. It can also be used to shape brows and moisturize cuticles.

avis.titre: Not What I Expected , Too Oily and Strong Smelling
avis.texte: I had high hopes for this product, but it didn't meet my expectations. I was expecting a cream based formula, but it's actually more of an ointment similar in texture to Vaseline. The scent was quite strong right out of the tube, and while others describe it as citrusy, I personally found it more reminiscent of insect repellent, which was off putting. The formula is very oily, so it took some effort to really rub it in and get it to absorb, which was more time consuming than I'd like. That said, once it finally settled into the skin, it did feel nice and moisturizing. I can see why some people swear by it, but unfortunately, it just didn't work for me

I received this from Influenster to try and review. I used it on my face first and while it was very moisturizing it surprisingly did not leave my skin greasy. It stayed soft for hours. So I tried it on my hands, I have horrible knuckles that are dry and crack in the winter. This worked great. I used it on my hands and arms. It's very effective. The only reason for 4 stars is the scent. It has a very odd off putting scent to it.

avis.titre: I love how easy on the skin and light it feels
avis.texte: This Elizabeth Arden 8 hour skin protectant is amazingly what every woman needs. The scent is like floral and lite so it's easy on the skin. The ingredients are all from natural plants so no harmful chemicals.
This product is definitely going to be a staple in my purse! It's so smooth and moisturizing. I slathered on my hands and cuticles. HIGHLY EFFECTIVE and quality

I was very much looking forward to trying Elizabeth Arden's Eight Hour Cream Skin Protectant. However, I ended up being disappointed. Don't get me wrong, my skin feels soft even hours after applying the cream. It looks and smells awful. The downside is that the place I need a skin protectant most is on my face but I can't stand having that smell linger. If EA could find a way to enhance the scent, I would absolutely buy it!!

I love the texture and the effect on your skin but I just don't like the smell maybe the ingredients aren't good because it's very strong I was expecting a reaction smell like roses or something flowers like but overall when I'm applying, I immediately wanna wash it off because of the smell, but I like the packaging like I said, I thought it was gonna smell at least decent enough to wear, but I like the way the moisture stays on your skin upon opening the package. The walls were seeping out of the pack.
I received Elizabeth Arden eight hour cream skin protector from influenster for free in exchange for my honest review. Loving this product, goes on smooth texture is cool like effective I'd recommend
Very versatile, there are so many ways you can use this product. Good quality ingredients and no strong scent. Super effective if you want to pay the price.

This cream is a game changer in my opinion! It has the softest, silkiest & creamiest texture & yet is so rich!! The scent didn't bother me, I didn't really notice one & as far as the effectiveness? It leaves your face with such hydration & suppleness! I will also never be without this Elizabeth Arden product!! I will purchase again & again! 10/10 recommend!

@elizabetharden and @influenster sent me this Elizabeth Arden eight hour skin protectant cream, which is good for moisturizing, as well as treats symptoms of chapping, sunburn, minor burns, windburn, dry hands and cracked lips. It can also be used to shape brows, revitalize shine, and smooth cuticles and nails. 💅 #ElizabethArden #influenster #complimentary

In my opinion this is a glorified vitamin d ointment. Feels awful applying to the face and doesn't smell great. That being said I'm sure if you had chapped cheeks or something it would be very helpful. In the meantime I'm using it as a foot ointment and putting on socks to lock it in. Definitely making my feet softer but I'm sure Vaseline would as well. Not worth the price to me.
I love this multi purpose cream. It is more of a gel which is interesting, but it works like a charm. It works on your face or body and does not cause any breakouts. There is no scent which I love.
the ingredients are safe and healthy the scent is okay packaging is nice and the texture is smooth this product works very effectively I would recommend

I really wanted to like the Elizabeth Arden Eight Hour Cream because of all the hype, but it was a huge disappointment. The smell is overpowering and honestly pretty gross — way too medicinal and heavy. The texture is even worse: insanely sticky, thick, and uncomfortable on the skin. It didn't absorb at all and just sat there feeling greasy and suffocating. I couldn't wait to wash it off. Definitely not worth the hype for me — I found it almost unusable.

This is called Right Hour Skin protectant. Originally, I thought this was a balm, that can be used for overnight moisture, for any type of the body. I have been using this on my hands, and it is hard to be absorbed by the skin. It leaves a natural oil finish, and it has a citrus scent, left on the skin. I recommend this on the external parts of the body, but not the face. I like the fact that the scent lasts a really long time on the external side of the skin. I would use this at night only, because during the day, I tend to wash my hands a lot and it can get slippery, when used during the day time.

This skin protectant is very helpful if you use it at night on your face. The smell is very strong and is not pleasant. However, it really does provide moisture for your face and hands! I recommend using it under your eyes at night to get the perfect amount of moisture. Even using it on your cuticles will keep them moisturized for hours.

I've been using using Elizabeth Arden Eight Hour Cream Skin Protectant for about a month now. I apply it to the areas that I find to be the most dry for me, elbows, hands and dry spots on my face!! It also works well on sunburns. It goes on smoothly leaving my skin soft and hydrated. It does have a smell to it that I'm not really fond of so I did dock a star for it.

avis.titre: A timeless, multi-purpose balm that hydrates, soot
avis.texte: Elizabeth Arden's Eight Hour Cream Skin Protectant is a legendary multitasking balm renowned for its ability to soothe, hydrate, and protect the skin. The apricot-tinted salve combines petrolatum, vitamin E, and salicylic acid to address various skin concerns, from chapped lips and dry patches to minor abrasions and windburn
This is a very thick cream that feels so luxurious on the skin. It is very moisturizing for both your skin and cuticles. The bottle is pretty and looks high end. Will definitely purchase again.

This is a product with a million uses! I have been loving putting it on my cuticles, eyebrows and dry skin areas. The packaging is high end and classic. The texture can be a little greasy so only a small amount is needed for application. The scent can be a little strong a first but fades away, there is no petroleum smell like other products just a light fragrance. There's a reason this has a cult following and will be an instant favorite!

avis.titre: Mix with other products for a glowy base
avis.texte: Interesting product - first of all, it's not a cream but it is a skin protectant. It's more like Vaseline and should be used in small quantities. I like to mix a small mount with lotion to give my skin a very moisturized glow. This has a very strong earthy scent (like sap?) which can be overwhelming if too much is used.

The Eight Hour Cream is a tried and true classic. I used it in the past and forgot just how amazing it is. It is multipurpose and instantly hydrates and soothes dry skin whether it be your cuticles, lips, dry patches on the face etc. It has a subtle medicinal scent that I enjoy. Glad to have been reminded how great this product is.

avis.titre: A Must-Have Healing Balm for Dry and Post-Treatmen
avis.texte: Elizabeth Arden Eight Hour Cream Skin Protectant is a true skincare essential—deeply hydrating and soothing even the driest areas. It works wonders on chapped lips, rough elbows, and minor skin irritations, with visible results almost instantly. It's also perfect for calming and nourishing skin that's peeling after treatments, helping to restore smoothness and comfort quickly.
Sleek package design with natural ingredients. Smooth texture and great scent. The product is effective and I will continue to use to keep up with the benefits. Definitely recommend!

This lotion is okay, it is extremely hydrating and was great for dry areas on my body but it didn't absorb that well and left a greasy feeling on my skin that I did not care for. The smell of this is also pretty bad, very overwhelming and not a pleasant smell, unfortunately.

avis.titre: Thick and good for dry skin but it has a strong sc
avis.texte: I appreciate the thickness of it as someone who suffers with dry skin and eczema. The only downside of it, is the smell. I really don't like the scent I personally think it's too strong. But other than that the product itself works well.

avis.titre: The texture is smooth and creamy and rubs in extre
avis.texte: After receiving the Elizabeth Arden Eight hour skin protectant cream, I tried it on my knees and elbows (that's where I get the driest and crack the most). The texture is smooth and creamy and rubs in extremely well, however it is a bit greasy feeling for a bit but does go away after a few minutes. Wish it had a better scent but I was pleased with the product

I've been using the Elizabeth Arden 8 Hour Skin Perfecting Daily Moisturizer for a few weeks now, and I'm genuinely impressed. It has a lightweight texture that absorbs quickly into the skin without feeling greasy, making it perfect for daily use under makeup or on its own. Love that it has a mild scent too!

avis.titre: Going to carry with me all the time
avis.texte: My hands were SO chapped the other day from the changing of temps going from cold to warm and vise versa and this 8hr creme helped immensely!! I love this product and it's so versatile. I am going to carry this in my purse all the time

I like that the product comes in a tube to maximize product. In general I do not love fragranced skincare and this scent is a bit strong. I do like the functionality in that that it is a multipurpose product.

I absolutely love this product! My hands looked instantly rejuvenated—it's like magic in seconds. The texture is rich but absorbs beautifully, and I'm obsessed with the refreshing, menthol-like sensation. It leaves my skin feeling deeply moisturized, smooth, and protected. A little goes a long way, and the results are truly noticeable. Highly recommend, especially for dry or tired-looking skin!
I didn't like the way it smelled. Also I'm still not entirely sure what it's for. I will do a bit more research. Other than that it was very easy to use and felt nice.
It's a very nice product. It actually does the job and moisturizer your skin. It fixes any dryness. It's packaged very well. The only downside for me is that it's has a strong medicine like smell.
A thick balmy hand lotion that instantly moisturizes and soothes dry hands. A light scent and nice packaging gives it a luxurious experience whenever it is used. A great gift!

avis.titre: Works good for severally dry and damaged skin
avis.texte: It absorbs good and light smell. Packaging is convenient. It's bit thick and gel thing to me but works as promised to work on severally dry and damage skin. It nourishes and fix skin well. Happy with it.

avis.titre: The scent is a bit unique and medicinal at first,
avis.texte: I've been using Eight Hour Cream Skin Protectant for a while now, and it has quickly become a must-have in my skincare routine. Whether I'm dealing with dry patches, chapped lips, or even minor skin irritations, this product delivers every time. The texture is rich and a little goes a long way. I especially love using it overnight — I wake up with noticeably softer, more hydrated skin. It's also fantastic for soothing rough cuticles and protecting skin in harsh weather.
The Elizabeth Arden Eight Hour Cream Skin Protectant does a good job of moisturizing. It does seem to be greasy, which is hard for me to overlook. The scent is clean & I do like that.
I absolutely LOVE this cream!! It is super thick, has a nice smell, and works wonders on my skin. It helps to keep my skin very hydrated and has helped heal some cracked skin!

This cream is very interesting and not what I expected at all! It's a yellow oil based cream that feels heavy on, its definitely moisturizing and since it forms this oil based barrier it's effective for hours. I find it best to apply at night where you know you won't be washing it away and the protective layer can do it's thing. The scent is oily, nothing too distinct.

avis.titre: Skin protecting cream for dry skin
avis.texte: The product is very effective in moisturizing and keeps my skin smooth. My hands usually get very dry when the weather gets colder and this skin protectant cream helps my skin smooth and hydrated. The scent seems like herbal to me but not too bad at all. The tube will definitely last long since I only need to use a bit each time, and I barely finish any part of it despite using it everyday since I received the product. I also use it on my feet to heal some cracks as well, and it definitely does the work wonderfully. I think the cream is definitely worth a try if you are looking for a hydrating cream for the wintertime

avis.titre: It hydrates your skin very well.
avis.texte: The Elizabeth Arden Eight Hour Cream Skin Protectant smell like medicine. The cream remind me of petroleum. When rub into your skin it really hydrate your skin. I use one my hand and also on my lips. The cream comes in a squeeze bottom which easy to comes out. I, myself would buy this product again.

Smooth and has a great scent. Safe ingredients and nice packaging. If I had more time using products I could give better feedback on them. Skin care products take longer time than we are given to test.

Great long acting cream moisturizer and skin protection. Great coverage and the ingredients do not bother my sensitive skin. Leaves a smooth finish and it's not greasy at all. Scent is pleasant and not overwhelming.

avis.titre: Very moisturizing, but the scent is not great
avis.texte: While this classic balm is super versatile and does a great job moisturizing dry areas like cuticles, I found it way too greasy for my taste and really didn't like the smell. I wouldn't use it on my face, but it's decent for rough spots, if you can get past the scent. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

I used this on my hands, feet and lips is very moisturizing and helped heal my cracked lips. I love that is a multi use cream for almost any part of your body and even can be use for eyebrows or part of your makeup routine. The only thing that I didn't like is the smell is not the worst but is not pleasant either. I would recommended specifically for winter time.

This lotion is a love hate for me. I love that it makes my hands so soft and bright after being on the computer all day. But I hate how it smells. It is not very pungent but it does leave an unpleasant smell on your hands. The bottle feels sturdy to put in your everyday bag.

At first I thought this was just for my face but then after carefully read it all I realized it is for skin in general to protect my skin so I started using on my hands. My hands use to become dry when it is cold outside or windy and this has been amazing to smooth my hands, cuticles and nails.

I was skeptical of Elizabeth Arden's eight hour cream before trying it… I've used it on my hands, nails and cuticles, my lips and my eyebrows and I am amazed with the results. My fingernails look more healthy and are growing beautifully and after this harsh winter, my chapped lips were craving the moisture and protection the ointment gives them. Even my eyebrows look more sculptured and fuller since using the cream. The only thing I would recommend is wait to apply to your eyebrows one day if you've just recently had them shaped. The 1.7 ounce cylinder is perfect to fit in my purse and pull out whenever I need it. Try Elizabeth Arden's eight hour cream, you can't go wrong.

avis.titre: Great for dry hands and chapped lips !!!
avis.texte: You need this cream from elizabeth arden. It deeply hydrates. I like to use it at night on my hands and on my lips as a lip mask and I wake up with the softest hands and lips. It has a pleasant citrusy scent.

This skin protectant works well. Very smooth texture it's a little thinner than vasaline and last through a few hand washes. I apply it around my nail bed because my skin peels there often and it's painful. This product helps a lot.

I have some dry spots around my nose. It helped to alleviate the severity of it with VERY Little needed. So seeing as it's the only spot I'd really need it it will last awhile. If you have a similar type spot, same deal. Works on hands as stated too. Smells slightly chemically.

This is a very moisturizing cream. Its really thick but absorbs quickly. I mainly use it on my hands and cuticles. I wash my hands often and have very dry skin so it moisturizes it quickly. I wish the smell was different, I don't love it.

The formula is very rich and feels more like a balm on the skin. It does leave a bit of a greasy feeling but it does feeling very healing and hydrating on the skin. Definitely great for severe dry of cracked skin.
Have been struggling with extra dry hands and cuticles, this has definitely helped. My hands are a lot more moisturized and the smell is pleasant.

avis.titre: Thick, emollient cream - Perfect for skin basting
avis.texte: This is a thick and emollient cream. This is the perfect cream for the new trend of skin basting! One generous layer over the face will lock in the moisture for the night and it made my skin super soft the following morning! The scent isn't my most favourite but for the way it performs, it isn't the most important part. The texture is very similar to petroleum jelly and also leaves behind a lovely shine behind!
Very good and very moisturizing. I wish I had this in the winter time when I was the most dry! Don't love the smell of the product but I can look past it. I think I will use mainly on my body.

I've been using this cult-favorite cream for a few weeks now, and I finally understand why it has such a legendary status. The texture is thick and balm-like, a little goes a long way. It instantly soothes dry or irritated skin — perfect for lips, cuticles, elbows, or even as a highlighter for that dewy look. I personally love using it overnight on my lips and hands, and by morning, everything feels soft and deeply hydrated. It also saved my skin during a windy day — no redness or dryness the next day! The scent is quite unique (a bit medicinal, herbal), but you get used to it. If you're looking for a multipurpose product that actually delivers results, this one's a keeper.
The product works very well for dry skin and other intended uses, but I just cannot get past the smell. It smells like a strong Vicks Vapo Rub and feels very greasy. Not my favorite
helped my skin get so glowy almost overnight. now a irreplaceable part of my night routine. it's expensive but it works, totally would recommend

This is a great cream. It is moisturizing with out being greasy. It absorbs quickly and soothes the skin. I use this on my elbows where I have a rough dry patch and it works fantastic. I am not huge fan of rhe scent, but it fades and does not linger.

avis.titre: it's giving grandma's scent - in a good way
avis.texte: this was an instant win for me though the scent did remind me a bit of my grandmother. This was a thick lotion that made my hands feel soft and protected. I ended up using it on a newish tattoo and it felt like it was a protective layer over the healing skin.

avis.titre: Strong fragrance and a bit sticky
avis.texte: Gel like texture with a scent of orange at first but after a while the scent just gets super strong (I mostly use unscented products so it might not be strong for others). It also feel very sticky at first and it gets less sticky as it settles in, which I don't like anything stickiness. Performance wise, it does what it supposed to do. I have dry spots and it moisturize it really fast. However because of the scent I won't be repurchase. I will use it for my legs for now.
Was not a fan, my face looked and felt greasy. I didn't care for the scent either. It was not pleasant to me. I eventually wiped it off before bed because I was just not a fan.

This is a petrolatum based product with 56.8% of it in this product. This is a multi use product for your hands, cuticle, face, chapped lips, sunburn, brows, etc. The gel is brownish, but applies on clear. It does leave a shiny oily look. It would be good for nighttime on the face. I use this also on my cuticles or my feet at night. My cuticles feel so much better. It is also good for very dry days on my hands. I am in California and we sometimes get dry winds and this is very helpful.
This is decent for what it is. It has a mildly medicinal scent. It melts easily into the skin and absorbs fairly quickly. I used it on my hands and they seemed to stay moisturized for quite awhile.

avis.titre: Wish it didn't have such a strong smell
avis.texte: I really wanted to love this product. The packaging is cute and I was excited about finally having a nice salve for rough spots and cuticles. I have to say after opening this product I could not get past the smell. It was astringent. It smelled like floor cleaner or really strong topical medication. With that said I did give it a shot for the sake of the review and it did provide a lot of moisture on cuticles without being too greasy. I just won't be using it in the future because of the strong smell unfortunately.

the scent kind of throws me off but the texture of this is very very nourishing for my super dry cuticles. it's a bit too thick on my skin so i prefer it for areas that are much drier. i think it also works great on cuts because of its occlusive texture

I received the skin protectant from Elizabeth Arden in exchange for a review. I use this on my hands as my eczema can sometimes cause excess dryness and cracking. This cream is a little greasy and has a strong smell. That said, it is very good at its job. One overnight use of this cream left my hands feeling healed and smooth the next morning. I recommend this if you are prone to dryness and cracking.

I received the Elizabeth Arden Eight Hour Skin Protectant from the brand and Influenster for my honest review. It is a heavy, petroleum product, more like a balm than a cream. It absorbs but you have to give it some time to fully absorb. It doesn't feel greasy once it absorbs. It has a medicinal scent. One of the uses listed on the package l is for eyebrow sculpting , but I wouldn't want the scent near my eyes. (There is a warning to avoid eye contact).
This is a pretty moisturizing cream. I mainly use it on my hands and especially for my cuticles. I have very dry hands and skin around my nails since I have to wash my hands so much for work.

I have heard great things about this skin protectant cream over the years so I was excited to get a chance to sample it myself!! It is a very emollient cream so a little goes a long way but it did wonders for softening my skin and keeping it hydrated. I had a small crack on my heel and with applying this cream for two nights, it was totally healed. I was not a huge fan of the scent, it wasn't bad, just a little strong for my personal taste but when a product works as well as this one does, I will overlook that. I definitely recommend this great product!!
I am absolutely in love with this!! I was hesitant to put on my lips since it can be used for cracked lips , however it worked out pretty nicely!! No harsh scent.

This definitely makes my skin feel good. Even after you wash your hands or body you can still feel it protecting your skin. I'm not a huge fan of the scent but it's not a deal breaker. This will be perfect for dry chapped winter skin.

I've used this product for years. It works very well for dry skin, I use it on little patches of dryness and on my lips. However I have always hated the sticky consistency. If they could change that it would be a solid five stars. It also smells so nice.

This is a super thick product consistency. It seems to really work. I put on my flaky skin after the retinol predict and it worked in one use. Didn't break my skin out. I don't love the smell but it's not awful either. Easy to squeeze tube design. Excited to use in future on chapped skin.

This cream is more of a thick, balm-like texture, but it's a total multitasker. It can be used on dry patches, cuticles, chapped lips, and even to tame brows and give cheekbones a natural glow which is incredible. It has a bit of a medicinal scent but the results make up for it. My skin feels instantly soothed and protected, especially during colder months or after using retinoids. It's not something I use all over my face daily, but as a targeted treatment, it's amazing.

I have been using this for only a week and my skin is already looking and feeling healthier. This protectant is better than any other petroleum based item I've used. It smells good and comes in a convenient tube.
I really like the ingredients in 8 hour. Cream skin protectant. It has a pleasant scent in the packaging is sturdy. I like the texture and smoothness of the cream.

avis.titre: Works well but has a strong scent.
avis.texte: This cream definitely does what it says it would do. I like to use it at bedtime. I don't really care for the scent and it's pretty strong. It's also a bit greasy.
This product has the smell of citronella ( which it contains) the texture is not a cream but an oil base . It was effective in lubricating my hands, but the feel and scent is terrible!
This is a great moisturizer!! It is an all in one product and it makes my skin look and feel amazing! The packaging is easy to use and the scent does not irritate my skin

I actually really like this product. The base feels like Vaseline but almost gives a minty/clean smell after rubbing it in. It's thick but too greasy where you're slipping everywhere. I probably won't use every day but as needed I can see there being a need for this in the summer to prevent chaffing.

I have recently been able to try this product. This product comes in nice looking packaging. It does not have a strong scent whatsoever. It's quite effective in dry skin for different parts of the body. But does work the same as Vaseline.
This skin protectant has a very strong scent, it smells like really old plastic band aids. Yuck! It doesn't appear to have any ingredients that would make it any better than just using Vaseline..

I've never used Elizabeth Arden, but I was really impressed with this product. The tube is a small sleek design. Cream has a nice smell and glides on smoothly. I tried it on my face as well as hands and my make up seemed to apply better. But my hands looked smoother after application.

The product feels nice on the skin I put it on some dry patches. It does seem like it helped moisturize them but this product is way too fragrant. I'm not sure if I'll will continue to use the product do to the strong fragrance maybe if I'm desperate

I didn't like this cream at all, it felt like a thick layer of sticky Vaseline, the smell was way to strong and not that pleasant, sort of like strong essential oils and pepper, my skin did feel soft once I finally got it washed off but it took four or five washes to get the oil film and smell to go away.

The Eight Hour Cream Skin Protectant is a true multitasking icon. Originally created in the 1930s, this cult-classic balm continues to be a skincare staple for beauty lovers around the world—and for good reason. Its rich, emollient formula helps soothe, protect, and heal dry or irritated skin almost instantly. Whether you're dealing with chapped lips, rough elbows, dry cuticles, windburn, or even minor scrapes, this cream delivers fast relief and long-lasting hydration. It creates a protective barrier that locks in moisture for up to eight hours, just as the name promises. Though it has a thick texture and a distinctive scent that may not be for everyone, the results speak for themselves. It also works beautifully as a natural highlighter or to tame brows and flyaways. If you're looking for a versatile, do-it-all product that truly performs, the Eight Hour Cream Skin Protectant is a timeless must-have.

This is a wonderful moisturizing cream that keeps my skin feeling hydrated, smooth, and dewy all day! I appreciate that it only contains clean ingredients that protect the skin. The packaging is also sleek and luxurious.

avis.titre: A versatile cream that's truly worth the investmen
avis.texte: At first, I found the Elizabeth Arden Eight Hour Cream a bit greasy and thick in texture and the smell is not my favourite, but I quickly realized how effective it is—especially for dry skin. It really helps soothe and repair rough patches, and I've started using it as part of my regular face care routine. It also works surprisingly well on minor cuts or wounds, helping them heal faster. It's kind of like a more luxurious version of Vaseline, but with better results. I even use it on my toddler's cracked feet, and it's been a game changer. A little goes a long way, and the results speak for themselves!

I don't get many fails on here but this one is just not working for me. It is more like an ointment than a cream and applies feeling greasy to me. It does do a good job creating a skin barrier and helped a cracked area I had when I used it but that was only once due to the scent. It was so strong and very medicinal smelling.

Elizabeth Arden Eight Hour Cream is the OG, created in 1930 to soothe and protect skin. It has been used by customers, including make up artists, worldwide because it is so versatile and consistent. This product is truly in a class by itself and is unlike anything else in the category. It contains vitamin E, salicylic acid and petrolatum and is designed to deeply moisturize and, more importantly, protect and soothe the skin. It can also literally be used anywhere on the body and for a wide variety of purposes - all over moisture, to heal cuts and scrapes, to treat sun and wind burns, to relieve chopping, to soften and smooth dry hands and cuticles, as a hydrating lip protectant, to tame hair and eyebrows….the list goes on! The two most interesting aspects of this product are its appearance and scent. Unlike similar healing ointments, this product is a brownish color, which when rubbed out is clear. The scent is very unique….hard to describe, but I'll take my best shot here….herbal-earthy-menthol. (as I said it does have a unique smell!) The texture is similar to Vaseline, but I find the healing properties far superior. And a very small amount goes a long way. This is one of those products that deserves a spot in everyone's home and bridges is the gap between a cosmetic/beauty product and a skin care staple.
